summary: One field-overlay slot (a following-party/marker actor plus its sprite) owned by the field Ui_Overlay: it fades in, walks to the followed actor, applies the queued overlay state change and removes itself.
evidence: Functions Ui_OverlaySlot_CreateSprite (0x0061A460), SetupFromRecord (0x0061AE4C), UpdateStateMachine (0x0061AF68) and ApplyStateChange (0x00237198) operate on one slot; SetupFromRecord stores the 'sprite' mesh in f_b8 and the child sprite index in f_298, UpdateStateMachine is a 0..11 state machine on the byte at +0x297. The class is polymorphic (virtual calls through *self+0x3c/+0x40/+0x54/+0x58) although the batch found no vtable.

fields.name: maybe_spriteResourceId
fields.evidence: CreateSprite/CreateSpriteWithArgs copy self->f_48 into the sprite-create parameter block (local_c = self->f_48) before Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh; role beyond 'resource/type word for the sprite' is not proven.

fields.name: maybe_actorPhaseId
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine state 10: (self[0x1f] - actor->f_7c) < 0x11 gates ApplyStateChange; the same actor field f_7c is also used as a position source, so this is an id/position compared with the followed actor.

fields.name: maybe_targetOffsetX
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine case 4 builds the move target as (float)self[0x26] + constant and passes it to func_005F3ADC (scene position); 0x98 is the unchanged X component.

fields.name: maybe_targetOffsetY
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine case 4 interpolates (float)self[0x27] toward the actor's height (fVar8 * 0.2) and stores it as the target Y; 0x9c is the Y component.

fields.name: maybe_positionZ
fields.evidence: SetupFromRecord copies rec+0xc into self->f_ac; ApplyStateChange copies it from the followed actor to the effect slot. Read together with f_b0/f_b4 as a 3-float transform.

fields.name: maybe_positionY
fields.evidence: SetupFromRecord copies rec+8 into self->f_b0; ApplyStateChange copies it from the followed actor to the effect slot.

fields.name: maybe_positionX
fields.evidence: SetupFromRecord copies rec+4 into self->f_b4; ApplyStateChange copies it from the followed actor. The three words f_ac/f_b0/f_b4 are always moved as a unit (a Vec3).

fields.name: spriteMesh
fields.evidence: CreateSprite: self->f_b8 = Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh(...), then sprite->f_129 = 10 (draw priority) and func_005E7650(self,self->f_b8); SetupFromRecord also writes f_b8->f_128 (frame) and f_b8->f_129 (priority 6).

fields.name: maybe_applyReady
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine state 10 sets self[0x32] = 1 immediately before applying the queued state change; only one access, so the exact meaning is open.

fields.evidence: Not a data field: the evidence line (*(code**)(*param_1+0x3c))(param_1,4) is a virtual call through vtable byte offset 0x3c; the offset 0xf0 in the batch is 0x3c*4 from pointer arithmetic.

fields.name: unknown_vtableSlot40
fields.evidence: Not a data field: (*(code**)(*param_1+0x40))(param_1,4) is a virtual call through vtable byte offset 0x40.

fields.evidence: Not a data field: (*(code**)(*param_1+0x54))(param_1,4) is a virtual call through vtable byte offset 0x54.

fields.name: childSpriteHandle
fields.evidence: SetupFromRecord: Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild(self,&config,&self->f_24c,0) returns the index stored in f_298; f_24c is the 0x60-byte add-child config/out block, not a plain scalar. Also referenced by TryInteract through the +0x204 sprite array.

fields.name: pendingStateChange
fields.evidence: ApplyStateChange: if (self->f_281 == 0) return; local_48 = self->f_281; self->f_281 = 0; then the low byte is the new state id and the high byte its variant (local_48._1_1_) - a queued 2-byte state-change command.

fields.name: state
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine switches on *(u8*)(self+0x297) with cases 0..11; BeginStateTransition only runs in state 0x0B; HandleCommandEnd moves to 8/6; TryInteract only in state 6.

fields.name: childSpriteId
fields.evidence: SetupFromRecord stores the Gfx_SpriteActor_AddChild result in f_298; TryInteract indexes the sprite array at self+0x204 with it and skips 0xFF (invalid).

fields.name: stateTimer
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine adds dt each frame: self[0xa7] = (int)((float)self[0xa7] + dt), then compares it with float bit patterns 0x40E66666 (7.2s) and 0x3E99999A (0.3s), and resets it on state entry.

fields.name: transitionPhase
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine's alternate branch switches on (char)self[0xa8] == 1 / == 2 and writes 0, 1, 2 or 3 through f_a8; distinct from the 0..11 state byte at +0x297, it tracks the pending fade-in/fade-out phase.

fields.name: fadeTimer
fields.evidence: UpdateStateMachine bottom: self[0xa9] accumulates dt, is reset to 0 when phase 1 completes and phase 2 waits until it reaches 0x3F000000 (0.5s).

fields.evidence: SetValue reads *(int*)(*(int*)(param_1+0x30)+0xAC)->0x14 for the number-animation resource; a UI object holding the number layout.

fields.name: colorState
fields.evidence: SetColoredValue: if (self->f_49 == color_state) keep the clip, else rebuild it; finally self->f_49 = (char)color_state (0 normal, 1 yellow, 2 red).

fields.name: colorClip
fields.evidence: SetColoredValue: Ui_PlayAnimByName(*(u32*)(self+4), 'num_normal'/'num_yellow'/'num_red',0,1) stores its result in self->f_4C and the value is written to f_4C->f_10.

fields.name: popup1Sprite
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_50->f_10->f_44 bit 0 toggles with value<10 - the ones-position sprite/visibility object.

fields.name: popup1Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_98->f_10 = digit for value<10 - the ones-position digit animation clip.

fields.name: popup2Sprite
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_a0->f_10->f_44 visibility toggled for value>=10.

fields.name: popup2Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_e8->f_10 = tens digit.

fields.name: popup3Sprite
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_f0->f_10->f_44 visibility toggled for value>=10.

fields.name: popup3Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_138->f_10 = units digit when the value is in 10..99.

fields.name: popup4Sprite
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_140->f_10->f_44 visibility toggled for value>=100.

fields.name: popup4Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_188->f_10 = hundreds digit.

fields.name: popup5Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_1d8->f_10 = tens digit of a 3-digit value (the matching sprite word at +0x190 was not emitted).

fields.name: popup6
fields.evidence: The batch evidence calls FUN_0029126C(param_1+0x1DC,0), the same widget binding used for the sixth in-place pop-up in Ui_DamagePopupGroup_Init.

fields.name: popup6Sprite
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_1e0->f_10->f_44 visibility toggled for 3-digit values.

fields.name: popup6Clip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_228->f_10 = hundreds digit of a 3-digit value.

fields.name: numberAnimClip
fields.evidence: SetValue: self->f_22C = Ui_PlayAnimByName(*(u32*)(self+4), 'pop_damage_num'/'...num2'/'...num3',0,1) is the size-specific number animation clip; cleared/released before each show.
